facts.fact: Kate 付了咖啡、贝果和 Elliot 没动的食物后走到外面；她已经感觉不到冷，因为她手上有了线索。
facts.anchor: She no longer noticed the cold, no longer noticed anything, because she now had something to go on.

facts.fact: Kate 现在知道 Olivia 不仅住过 Emily 的房子，还住同一间前排卧室——Emily 就是在那里被杀。
facts.anchor: Olivia Kavanagh, she now knew, had not only lived in Emily Pierce’s house but occupied the same bedroom, the one at the front in which Emily was killed.

facts.fact: Elliot 承认他替 Olivia 把写给 Dr Aiden Berkeley 的邮件写完并背着 Olivia 发了出去。
facts.anchor: Elliot had told her he’d completed the email and sent it behind her back.

facts.fact: Elliot 说 Emily 的事是他告诉 Millie、Millie 再传给别人；他把 Olivia 的死也揽到自己身上。
facts.anchor: It was me who told them about Emily. Well, I told Millie, and she told the others. And now Olivia’s dead.

facts.fact: Kate 要到 Elliot 的电话号码，并答应不把他说的话告诉别人。
facts.anchor: She persuaded him to give her his number and promised not to repeat anything he’d told her.

facts.fact: Kate 决定暂不报警：她不愿把自己的线索和潜在独家交给警方。
facts.anchor: It wasn’t in her interest to go to the police with this, not for the meantime. She didn’t trust them with her lead, her potential exclusive.

facts.fact: Kate 推断 Aiden Berkeley 已不在 Leeds，因为 Elliot 说那是 Cardiff University 的邮箱。
facts.anchor: Elliot said it was a Cardiff University email address, so I’m guessing not.

facts.fact: Kate 提议自己溜去 Cardiff 直接找那位教授，并对同行和报社都保密。
facts.anchor: How about I slip off to Cardiff, go knock the pervy prof and see what he has to say for himself? We’ll keep it on the down-low.

facts.fact: 她在公开场合只用手尖碰他的手臂，心里想自己真的可能爱上他。
facts.anchor: She hoped no one was watching. She really could fall in love with him, she decided.

facts.fact: 章末她开车去 Cardiff，完全没有想到要担心见 Aiden Berkeley 这件事。
facts.anchor: It did not occur to her to worry about meeting Aiden Berkeley.
